The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's at step 128. By step 124 it had opened the Dastardly Mash headstone image, which was the oldest flavor at 1979-1991. It was asked to read the rhyme on the headstone visible behind it, but it returned only a generic description of the page. It never identified the background headstone or its rhyme. The run then hit the round limit and ended with a wrong final answer.

An earlier misstep was the guess that Wavy Gravy might be the oldest flavor (steps 26 and 28), but the run recovered from it and found Dastardly Mash by step 97.

STEP: 128
